map.高斯公式：1/f = 1/u + 1/v（实物距 u>0，凸透镜 f>0）。: Gaussian formula: 1/f = 1/u + 1/v (real object distance u>0, convex lens f>0).
map.像距 v>0 为实像（屏可接收），v<0 为虚像；放大率 m<0 表示倒立。: Image distance v>0 is a real image (can be caught on a screen), v<0 is a virtual image; magnification m<0 means inverted.
map.由物距与焦距算像距、放大率。: From the object distance and focal length, compute the image distance and magnification.
map.凸透镜 f=10cm、物距 u=−15cm（实物）→ 1/v=1/10−1/15: Convex lens f=10cm, object distance u=−15cm (real object) → 1/v=1/10−1/15=0.0333 → v=30cm (real image), magnification m=−v/u=2× inverted and magnified.
map.物距 u=−5cm<f → 1/v=1/10−1/5=−0.1 → v=−10c: Object distance u=−5cm<f → 1/v=1/10−1/5=−0.1 → v=−10cm (virtual image), m=2× upright and magnified, the principle of a magnifier.
map.实物距 u 负、实像 v 正、虚像 v 负；m=−v/u，负为倒立。统一符号才不: Real object distance u is negative, real image v is positive, virtual image v is negative; m=−v/u, negative means inverted. A consistent sign convention avoids errors.
map.放大镜几倍？: How many times does a magnifier magnify?
map.M≈25/f(cm)，f=10cm→2.5×；物越近（<f）放大越大但像越远越糊: M≈25/f(cm); f=10cm→2.5×. The closer the object (f), the greater the magnification, but the farther and blurrier the image.
